description: This file contains the implementation of a query handler for listing articles within a Conduit feature, handling filtering options such as tag, author, favorited user, feed status, pagination, and ordering, using Entity Framework Core for data access.

classes.name: List
classes.description: A feature class encapsulating the query and handler for listing articles, supporting filtering and pagination.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the article listing query asynchronously, applying filters based on provided parameters, handling user feed, tags, authors, and favorites, and returning an articles envelope with results and count.
